_note: agent_create_only_in: an agent may land new items here, and into a human zone only with a human approval. agent_edit_never: an agent may not rewrite content in these zones at all, approved or not -- the legal path is a new note in 00_Inbox that a human merges. zone_check.py validates this file: a rule naming a zone that does not exist, or leaving a human zone unprotected, is rejected before any proposal is judged.
